audit.whatIsWrong: Smoke Screen is called a blind and his passive is called an 'armor-shred passive'.
audit.why: Riot: Smoke Screen reduces sight range and slows — it nearsights, it does not make his autos miss. New Destiny is the shotgun and reload passive; the armour comes from Quickdraw's True Grit, and there is no shred anywhere in his kit.
audit.corrected: Nearsight and True Grit written in place of blind and armour-shred.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 phase is generic boilerplate about your Q-poke winning while the side is Graves.
audit.why: New Destiny gives him a magazine he must reload, so the real early rule is punishing the reload rather than trading through it.
audit.corrected: Level 1 why rewritten around the reload window and Granite Shield.

audit.whatIsWrong: The single biggest interaction is absent: New Destiny's bullets cannot pass through units, so standing behind your own minions eats his autos outright.
audit.why: Riot's description of New Destiny states his attacks fire four bullets which cannot pass through units. Against a melee tank that is a free spacing rule for the whole laning phase.
audit.corrected: Minion-block interaction added to the TL;DR, Key Ability Interactions, the level-1 spike and the level-1 why.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldown block names Quickdraw but gives no numbers, and Smoke Screen's very long cooldown is never mentioned.
audit.why: Smoke Screen is 26s at rank 1 down to 18s, Quickdraw 16s to 12s, End of the Line 13s to 6s, Collateral Damage 100/80/60. Smoke Screen is the punishable one.
audit.corrected: Real cooldowns written into the cooldown breakdown and the first Do.

edits.before: Bait his key tool — Q-poke him down and hold R for the game-winning engage. Malphite wins the Quickdraw cooldown windows.
edits.after: His bullets cannot pass through minions — space behind the wave and hold R. Malphite wins the Quickdraw windows.

edits.before: Q-poke wins level 1 and the move-speed steal compounds. Identify how Graves contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: New Destiny gives him a magazine he has to reload, and his bullets stop on minions. Stand behind the wave and last-hit at range.

edits.before: - Graves Quickdraw: matchup-defining — His dash + armor stacks. Engage when it's down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Smoke Screen (W): 26s at rank 1, 18s at rank 5 — his longest cooldown and your window. - Quickdraw (E): 16s, his only reposition, so R him after it. - Collateral Damage (R): 100/80/60. - Your ultimate: 130s.

edits.before: Track Graves's Quickdraw: His dash + armor stacks. Engage when it's down. When it is down — Q-poke, R the pick.
edits.after: New Destiny bullets cannot pass through units — stand behind a minion. Smoke Screen nearsights you, it does not blind him.

edits.before: His dash + armor stacks. Engage when it's down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His only reposition, 16s at rank 1. Land the point-blank R the moment it is spent.

edits.before: Graves' double-tap shotgun autos plus Smoke Screen blind out-trade you before W's armor stack and E's attack-speed slow are online — eat it and farm.
edits.after: Graves' shotgun autos plus a Smoke Screen nearsight out-trade you before W's armor stack and E's attack-speed slow exist — stand behind minions and farm.

edits.before: Drop Smoke Screen on you and double-tap with shotgun autos to win every pre-6 trade through the blind
edits.after: Drop Smoke Screen to nearsight you, then unload the shotgun magazine to win every pre-6 trade

edits.before: Use his E Quickdraw dash and armor-shred passive to kite back and reset spacing whenever you Q-slow him
edits.after: Use Quickdraw (E) and its True Grit resists to kite back and reset spacing whenever you Q-slow him

edits.before: Graves' level-1 double-tap autos plus an early Smoke Screen blind out-trade your no-pattern start — neither of you fights well here, so just last-hit at Q range.
edits.after: His shotgun and an early Smoke Screen out-trade your no-pattern start, but his bullets stop on minions — last-hit at Q range from behind the wave.

notes: Graves' bullets-blocked-by-units line comes straight from Riot's New Destiny description and is the highest-value addition here. Malphite's kit derives a 'grounding' flag on Seismic Shard and Ground Slam that Riot's descriptions do not support (move-speed steal and attack-speed reduction only); no grounding claim written.
